data.body: LIVE verification update (2026-09-09 04:03-04:05 UTC): merged Gerrit change 2866 as f9343fcd56422e894be4dea90221e8c8edb4f885, applied Terraform after merge (1 added, 1 changed, 0 destroyed), and installed the refreshed observability helper on i-00880b2c7f13527c5. Corrected the host volume-id marker to exactly vol-06780b8557d1416b7 with trailing newline (it had a literal 'n' from an earlier manual write), then exercised /usr/local/bin/rebar-observability.sh. Evidence: rebar-assert-volumes-in-service.py --metric-value --volume-id vol-06780b8557d1416b7 --mount /var/lib/rebar/gate-scratch returned 1; journal logged 'gate scratch volume vol-06780b8557d1416b7 at /var/lib/rebar/gate-scratch in_service=1'; CloudWatch rebar/host gate_scratch_volume_in_service has a value 1 datapoint for InstanceId=i-00880b2c7f13527c5, VolumeId=vol-06780b8557d1416b7, mount=/var/lib/rebar/gate-scratch; alarm rebar-gate-scratch-volume-not-in-service is OK. Workloads are on the scratch XFS mount (/dev/nvme2n1 -> /var/lib/rebar/gate-scratch). This satisfies the recurring live metric/alarm gap added to AC6.
